knowledgePoints.title: 一、拼写规则
knowledgePoints.content: 规则动词的过去式和过去分词的拼写规则：

subPoints.title: 以辅音字母加y结尾的动词
subPoints.content:
先把y改成i再加ed。但以元音字母加y结尾直接加ed。
study- studied, carry- carried, copy- copied
play- played, obey- obeyed, destroy- destroyed

subPoints.title: 以一个辅音字母结尾的重读闭音节动词
subPoints.content:
先双写这个辅音字母再加ed。
plan-planned, stop- stopped, prefer- preferred, infer- inferred
admit–admitted, ban- banned, beg- begged, hug- hugged

knowledgePoints.title: 二、读音规则
knowledgePoints.content: 规则动词的过去式和过去分词的读音规则：

subPoints.title: /t/
subPoints.content:
以清辅音结尾，ed读作/t/
embarrassed, wished, watched, shocked, laughed

subPoints.title: /d/
subPoints.content:
以浊辅音或元音结尾，ed读作/d/
 begged, breathed, described, learned, reserved, viewed, poured

subPoints.title: /ɪd/
subPoints.content:
以/t/或/d/结尾，ed读作/ɪd/
concentrated, debated, depended, pretended

exercises.question: He said that the project ________ (complete) soon.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去将来时的被动语态

exercises.question: They ___________ (inform) to come on time last night.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时的被动语态，以e结尾加d

exercises.question: Lady Meng Jiang's husband __________ (force) to build the Great Wall just three days after they got married.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时的被动语态，以e结尾加d

exercises.question: She ___________ (carry) on working even though she was feeling tired.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时，以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加ed

exercises.question: In the past few decades, eBooks __________ (develop) dramatically.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时，以辅音字母结尾，以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加ed

exercises.question: He __________ (refer) to the watch and announced it was time to leave.
exercises.explanation: 一般过去时，以重读闭音节结尾，双写r加ed

exercises.question: She has greatly __________ (benefit) from the training program.
exercises.explanation: 现在完成时，以fit结尾，双写t加ed
